content: Does there exist a publicly available context free grammar for Lean?
This topic was moved here from #general > Context Free Grammar for Lean by Alexandre Rademaker.
Do you mean to reason about context-free grammars in Lean, or to parse Lean using a context-free grammar?
@Alexandre Rademaker Thanks for this. What I am really looking for is if there is a context free grammar of the Lean programming language itself, whether in BNF, EBNF, ANTLR or something similar.
Nope. As far as I understand lean parsing all rules get tried and the longest matching rule wins. Nothing stops you from custom defining syntax like "+" The parser will then try both of those out.
unfortunately, the fact that you can extend lean's language in the language itself means it isn't context free...
